name: Adept Benefit (Amulet)
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn after Amulet's Abeyance): resistance 5 to one damage type chosen when the mode is switched on; the resistance is 10 instead at character level 15+.

name: Aged Arbor Wine
effects: For 1 minute after drinking: you gain tremorsense with a range of 30 feet. (The writhing vegetation that makes a 20-foot emanation difficult terrain is battlefield-only and needs nothing.)

name: Arbor Wine
effects: For 1 minute after drinking: you gain tremorsense with a range of 30 feet.

name: Arctic Worm Chitin Shield
effects: While active (from Raising the shield with Misty Chill until the beginning of your next turn): resistance 5 to cold. The 3d6 cold damage to creatures ending their turn adjacent to you is a target-side effect.

name: Blood Booster (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes after drinking: resistance 5 to persistent bleed damage and resistance 5 to persistent poison damage; flat checks to end persistent bleed or persistent poison are made at the reduced DC 10 (as if you had received particularly appropriate aid).

name: Bloodhound Mask (Greater)
effects: For 8 hours after activating the mask: you gain imprecise scent with a range of 60 feet, and your proficiency bonus for Survival checks to Track by scent is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

name: Bloodhound Mask (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes after activating the mask: you gain imprecise scent with a range of 15 feet, and your proficiency bonus for Survival checks to Track by scent is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

name: Bloodhound Mask (Moderate)
effects: For 1 hour after activating the mask: you gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet, and your proficiency bonus for Survival checks to Track by scent is equal to your level even if untrained. You can't wear another mask while wearing it.

name: Bloodhound Olfactory Stimulators
effects: For 1 minute after activating (once per day): you gain imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet.

name: Break the Sun's Legs
effects: For the 1-minute duration: you gain greater darkvision (the surrounding area is under a 9th-rank Darkness effect).

name: Chromatic Jellyfish Oil (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes: resistance 5 to precision damage and to the extra damage from critical hits; you ignore difficult terrain from tight spaces that don't force a Squeeze; you move 5 feet per round when you succeed at Squeeze (10 feet on a critical success); you can Crawl at half your Speed.

name: Clockwork Goggles
effects: For 10 minutes you gain low-light vision.

name: Clockwork Goggles (Greater)
effects: For 10 minutes you gain low-light vision and darkvision.

name: Clockwork Goggles (Major)
effects: For 10 minutes you gain low-light vision, darkvision, and the effects of See the Unseen (you can see invisible creatures as concealed).

name: Close Formation
effects: While wielding two fans, one in each hand, you have imprecise tremorsense with a 20-foot range.

name: Curse of Creeping Ashes
effects: Exclusive stage modes in the oracle-cursebound group. Stage 1: weakness 2 to fire and any fire immunity or resistance you have is suppressed. Stage 2: additionally a -2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls. Stage 3: fire weakness becomes 5 + your level. Stage 4: additionally a -10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds.

name: Curse of Inclement Headwinds
effects: Exclusive stage modes in the oracle-cursebound group. Stage 1: weakness 2 to electricity, you count as wearing metal for electricity effects, and any electricity immunity or resistance is suppressed. Stage 2: additionally a -2 circumstance penalty to your ranged attack rolls. Stage 3: electricity weakness becomes 5 + your level. Stage 4: additionally a -10-foot status penalty to all your Speeds.

name: Curse of Inevitable Rot
effects: Exclusive stage modes in the oracle-cursebound group. Stage 1: weakness 2 to acid and to poison. Stage 2: additionally a -1 status penalty to saving throws against diseases and poisons, and a -1 status penalty to anyone's skill check to Treat your Disease, Poison or Wounds. Stage 3: acid and poison weakness becomes twice your level. Stage 4: those status penalties become -2.

name: Curse of the Living Death
effects: Exclusive stage modes in the oracle-cursebound group. Stage 1: weakness 2 to vitality and to void; you can be targeted and damaged by both even if one normally would not affect you, and any immunity or resistance to either is suppressed. Stage 2: additionally a -1 status penalty to Fortitude saves. Stage 3: vitality and void weakness becomes 5 + your level. Stage 4: the Fortitude penalty becomes -2.

name: Curse of the Mortal Warrior
effects: Exclusive stage modes in the oracle-cursebound group. Stage 1: weakness 2 to any damage dealt by a spell, and any immunity or resistance you have to spells is suppressed. Stage 2: additionally a -1 status penalty to saving throws against spells. Stage 3: the weakness to spell damage equals your level. Stage 4: the status penalty against spells becomes -2.

name: Darkvision Elixir (Greater)
effects: For 24 hours you gain darkvision.

name: Darkvision Elixir (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes you gain darkvision.

name: Darkvision Elixir (Moderate)
effects: For 1 hour you gain darkvision.

name: Deployable Cover (Ballistic Cover)
effects: While you have cover from Taking Cover behind a deployed ballistic cover: resistance 2 to piercing damage from ranged weapons and ranged unarmed attacks (in addition to the standard cover's +2 circumstance bonus to AC).

name: Devilwing Badge
effects: While the spellheart is affixed to your armor: resistance 2 to fire and resistance 2 to unholy.

name: Devilwing Badge (Greater)
effects: While the spellheart is affixed to your armor: resistance 5 to fire and resistance 5 to unholy.

name: Dissolution's Sight
effects: For 1 minute you gain greater darkvision (usable once per hour).

name: Draft of Stellar Radiance
effects: For 1 minute: a -20 penalty to your Stealth checks, and you emanate bright light in a 20-foot radius (dim light for 20 feet beyond). Creatures that target you with an attack or ability must save or be dazzled for 1 round.

name: Dragon's Eye Charm
effects: Golden shroud activation (once per day): fire resistance 5 for 10 minutes. Pupil activation (once per day): darkvision while you Sustain, up to 10 minutes. Fourth activation lets you speak and understand Draconic while Sustained, up to 10 minutes.

name: Echoes in Stone
effects: Until the start of your next turn you have imprecise tremorsense with a 20-foot range (requires standing on a stone or earthen surface).

name: Elder Seed
effects: Exclusive stage modes. Stage 1: resistance to bludgeoning and piercing equal to your level; tremorsense 30 feet. Stage 2: additionally low-light vision, Clumsy 1, a -1 status penalty to initiative, weakness to fire equal to half your level and the same amount of extra damage from axes. Stage 3: Clumsy 2, a -2 status penalty to initiative, fire and axe weakness equal to your level, and you are Slowed 1 whenever you roll initiative (Slowed 2 on a d20 of 10 or lower, Slowed 3 on a 1).

name: Energetic Meltdown
effects: Until your next daily preparations you gain weakness equal to floor(level/3) to the energy type of your deviant backlash (player picks the type: acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic), and you lose immunity to that damage type if you had it.

name: Energy Adaptive
effects: Resistance 5 to one damage type the player picks among acid, cold, electricity, and fire; persists until the rune is activated again or the armor is no longer invested (once per hour to switch).

name: Energy Mutagen (Lesser)
effects: For 1 minute: resistance 5 to one energy type the player picks (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and weakness 5 to each of the other three; +1 damage of the attuned type on a melee weapon hit.

name: Energy Mutagen (Moderate)
effects: For 10 minutes: resistance 10 to one energy type the player picks (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and weakness 5 to each of the other three; +1d4 damage of the attuned type on a melee weapon hit.

name: Energy Mutagen (Greater)
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 15 to one energy type the player picks (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and weakness 5 to each of the other three; +1d6 damage of the attuned type on a melee weapon hit.

name: Energy Mutagen (Major)
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 20 to one energy type the player picks (acid, cold, electricity, or fire) and weakness 5 to each of the other three; +2d6 damage of the attuned type on a melee weapon hit.

name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
effects: For 10 minutes, resistance equal to floor(level/2) to all damage dealt by the one weapon that swore the vow. On a plain success the remaining duration drops by 1 minute each time that weapon hits you.

name: Feral Senses
effects: While the shape is active you gain low-light vision and imprecise scent with a range of 30 feet. (Exclusive polymorph form entered with an action, so it belongs with the other battle forms in the stances registry, where senses are already supported.)

name: Fire and Iceberg
effects: For 1 minute after eating: resistance 5 to fire and resistance 5 to cold.

name: Force Shield
effects: For 1 minute (once per day): resistance 5 to physical damage. Ends early if you stop holding the shield.

name: Forge Warden
effects: While the forge warden is raised you have fire resistance 5. (Allies adjacent to you get it too, but that is their sheet.)

name: Form a Flock
effects: Up to 1 minute: 25 temporary Hit Points, and weakness 5 to area damage and splash damage while the flock surrounds you. Ends when the temporary HP are gone, the minute elapses, or you Dismiss it.

name: Fresh Produce
effects: For 10 minutes after eating the produce: resistance 2 to void damage, increasing by 2 for every 2 levels above 1st (4 at 3rd, 6 at 5th, and so on). You also cannot eat another piece while it lasts.

name: Frost Breath
effects: Resistance 5 to cold while the bottled breath is held, until you exhale it as the cone or the effect ends.

name: Galvanic Chew
effects: For up to 1 hour: resistance 5 to electricity. Ends early if you spend the Secondary Effect reaction, which makes the chew inert.

name: Geomancer Dedication
effects: One mode per self-affecting attunement, each active for 1 round after casting a matching spell: Aquatic - swim Speed equal to your land Speed (and you may use it as your land Speed on a surface); Mountain - resistance to physical damage except adamantine equal to the rank of the spell cast; Plains - temporary Hit Points equal to the spell's rank; Underground - darkvision and imprecise tremorsense out to 15 feet. Arctic, Desert, Forest and Swamp affect enemies only and need nothing.

name: Ghostcaller's Planchette
effects: Until the start of your next turn after you cast a spell by Activating the planchette: resistance 5 to all physical damage, except that attacks by incorporeal creatures and ghost touch attacks bypass it.

name: Goz Mask (Major)
effects: For 1 hour (once per day): you gain darkvision, and you ignore all concealment caused by environmental effects such as fog, rain and storms.

name: Grim Specter
effects: Up to 1 minute, once per day: you become incorporeal - immune to precision damage and to effects requiring a physical body including most diseases and poisons, and you gain resistance to all damage equal to half the relic's level, doubled against non-magical damage. Force damage, ghost touch attacks, spirit damage, void damage and vitality damage ignore this resistance. You are slowed 1 on any turn you start inside an object.

name: Grolna
effects: For 1 hour after a 1-minute onset: gain scent (imprecise) 30 feet as a new sense, and you are Stupefied 1. Stage 2 replaces it with Stupefied 2 for 6 hours.

name: Harden Flesh
effects: Until the beginning of your next turn you have resistance to physical damage (except adamantine) equal to 3, +1 at 12th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of 6 at 20th. Requires standing on earthen or stone ground.

name: Horned Lion Amulet
effects: For 1 minute you have fire resistance 5. The triggering instance of fire damage is instead reduced by fire resistance 10, and if it was persistent fire damage you immediately attempt a flat check to end it (DC stays 10 until the persistent damage ends).

name: Iron Wine
effects: For 10 minutes your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 1d4 fire damage. A separate toggle for a second cup in one day: you gain weakness 5 to fire until your next daily preparations.

name: Kinetic Dampening
effects: Until the beginning of your next turn you have resistance to physical damage equal to 5, +5 at 10th level and every 4 levels thereafter. With the second Awakening, also resistance of the same value to your choice of fire, electricity or sonic (player picks the type).

name: Living Statue
effects: While standing on the earth you have resistance 5 to physical damage except adamantine; this becomes resistance 8 in caves or subterranean environments.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Lesser)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 2 to spirit damage.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Major)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 10 to spirit damage.

name: Maelstromic Destabilizer (Moderate)
effects: For 1 minute the holder has resistance 5 to spirit damage.

name: Saurian Spike (Major)
effects: While the spellheart is affixed to armor: gain precise scent with a range of 60 feet.

name: Scouring Spark
effects: Immune to the confused and frightened conditions; unarmed Strikes deal +1d6 fire damage; your fire spells deal one additional damage die of the spell's own die type. (Creatures that touch you taking 3d6 is target-facing.)

name: Shadow Master
toggleName: Shadow Master (in dim light or darkness)
effects: Resistance 5 to all damage except force damage and damage from Strikes with the Ghost Touch property rune; roll Reflex saves twice and take the higher result (fortune).

name: Shadow Sight
effects: For 1 minute (once per hour), gain the greater-darkvision sense.

name: Siccatite Buckler (High-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 10 to the opposing energy type — cold if it is a hot siccatite shield, fire if it is a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Buckler (Standard-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Shield (High-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 10 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Siccatite Shield (Standard-Grade)
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to the opposing energy type — cold for a hot siccatite shield, fire for a cold siccatite shield. The player must first record whether the shield is hot or cold.

name: Spell Survivor
effects: Until the end of that caster's next turn, gain resistance to all damage dealt by the caster whose spell you critically saved against: resistance 1, increasing by 1 at 9th level and every 4 levels thereafter (2 at 9th, 3 at 13th, 4 at 17th).

name: Spiny Lodestone
effects: While affixed to armor: +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and resistance 2 to nonlethal damage.

name: Spiny Lodestone (Greater)
effects: While affixed to armor: +1 item bonus to Athletics checks and resistance 5 to nonlethal damage.

name: Spun Cloud (Blue)
effects: While you are inside the exhaled blue cloud (20-foot burst, lasts 1 minute), gain resistance 5 to electricity.

name: Starlight Armor
effects: For 1 minute (once per day): resistance 7 to piercing, bludgeoning and slashing damage, increasing to 10 at 17th level. (The dazzling save for adjacent attackers is target-facing.)

name: Stone Body Mutagen (Lesser)
effects: For 10 minutes: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning; all Speeds reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet); −2 penalty to Reflex saves.

name: Stone Body Mutagen (Moderate)
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 5 to physical damage except bludgeoning; all Speeds reduced by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet); −2 penalty to Reflex saves.

name: Storm Breath
effects: While the breath is held: resistance 5 to electricity and resistance 5 to sonic damage.

name: Sun Slayer
effects: While this shield is Raised, you gain resistance 5 to fire damage.

name: Swarmsuit
effects: While wearing the swarmsuit and fighting swarms: resistance 3 to physical damage from swarms.

name: Tallowheart Mass
effects: For 1 minute after rubbing a portion on your body: resistance 10 to fire damage. (Separate portions instead grant quickened 1 for 1 minute usable only for held-weapon Strikes, or heal 4d8+12 — the mass has three portions total.)

name: Thorn of Milani (Lesser)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after activating the thorn: weakness 1 to unholy. The triggering Strike also deals an extra 1d4 spirit damage with the holy trait.

name: Thorn Triad
toggleName: Thorn Triad — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 2 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (4 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thorn Triad (Greater)
toggleName: Thorn Triad (Greater) — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 4 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (8 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thorn Triad (Major)
toggleName: Thorn Triad (Major) — Armor (after a plant spell)
effects: Until the end of your next turn after casting a plant spell by activating the triad: resistance 6 to bludgeoning and piercing damage (12 if the spell was not a cantrip) and weakness 3 to fire.

name: Thousand-Year Dragonroot
effects: For 1 minute: gain a fly Speed of 40 feet and resistance 5 to fire damage; your body sheds light as a torch.

name: Tremorsensors
effects: While active (10 minutes, once per day): you gain tremorsense as an imprecise sense with a range of 20 feet. No numeric modifiers; the granted sense is carried as the mode note, exactly like item-pallesthetic-mutagen's tremorsense/echolocation note.

name: Vengeful Remnant
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn, or the end of your next turn if you slay a significant foe with the Spectral Dagger): resistance 10 to all damage except force, ghost touch, spirit and vitality; resistance 20 instead against non-magical damage.

name: Victory Plate
effects: For 1 minute: resistance 5 to one damage type chosen from the recorded creature's trait — mental (aberration/fey), good (celestial), poison (construct), a matching energy type (dragon/elemental), evil (fiend), void (undead), or precision at resistance 10 (ooze).

name: Warcaller's Chime of Resistance
effects: For 10 minutes (once per week): resistance 5 to one chosen damage type — acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic.

name: Warming Parka
effects: For 1 minute (once per day, dismissable): resistance 3 to cold damage, and Perception drops by 2 (a -2 item penalty). The always-on environmental-cold reduction stays in the note — it is GM/environment adjudicated.

name: Witch's Finger
effects: For 1 hour: resistance 3 to cold damage. Note (8 hours): negates severe environmental cold damage and reduces extreme cold to severe.

name: Wyrm Spindle
effects: For 1 minute after casting a non-cantrip spell by Activating the spindle: resistance 5 to fire, force, mental and spirit. Note: the Weapon benefit instead grants a 2-action Dragon Breath (6d6, once before the end of your next turn).

name: Zetogeki Hide Armor
effects: Until the end of your next turn (once per day): resistance 5 to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage, and every Speed drops by 10 feet (minimum 5 feet).

name: Bioluminescent Stripes
effects: While the stripes glow (activate 1 action, dismiss as a free action): Stealth drops by 4 (a -4 item penalty), applying to Hide and Sneak. Note: you can't be undetected, and you shed bright light in a 20-foot radius plus dim light for the next 20 feet.

name: Blessed Tattoo
effects: While active (1 minute): AC rises by 1 and every saving throw rises by 1 (a +1 status bonus), applying only against attacks, spells and effects created by evil/unholy creatures.

name: Curse of Engulfing Flames
effects: While active: you take persistent fire damage equal to your cursebound value, and any fire immunity or fire resistance you have is suppressed (treated as none). Ends while Refocusing to assuage the curse or while unconscious.

name: Electric Counter
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): resistance to electricity equal to your level.

name: Gathering Moss
effects: While active (1 minute, or until Tenacious Stance ends): fast healing equal to your level.

name: Immortal Techniques
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): 20 temporary Hit Points, gained the first time each round you use an action with the monk and stance traits.

name: Inexorable Iron
effects: While in Arcane Cascade stance wielding a melee weapon in two hands: gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level (minimum 1) on entering the stance and at the start of each of your turns.

name: Klingegeist
effects: Alternate form (10 minutes or until Dismissed): AC becomes 18 + your level; you gain a fly Speed of 30 feet; you are trained in the possessed slashing weapon unless already better; you can take only Strike and Fly actions.

name: Leopard's Armor
effects: 1 hour: +2 item bonus to Stealth; +2 item bonus to Intimidation checks to Demoralize; -2 penalty to Diplomacy; -2 penalty to Society.

name: Pyrefeather Token
effects: 1 minute: 5 temporary Hit Points. On activation it also reduces the DC of the triggering recovery check by 1.

name: Renewing Cycle
effects: While active (until the start of your next turn): temporary Hit Points equal to half your level, gained the first time each round you Cycle Elemental Stance.

name: Soaring Wings (Major)
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. No frequency limit; lasts until you Dismiss it. No other statistic changes.

name: Stone Body
effects: While active: resistance 10 to all damage. Requires Tenacious Stance; ends at the end of your next turn or immediately when you are critically hit.

name: Stone Brawler Dedication
effects: While in the stance you can make stonestrike attacks: 1d8 bludgeoning, brawling group, traits forceful, magical, unarmed. Requires that you are standing on the ground. (Text verified against core.actions['stonestrike-stance'].)

name: Winged
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to 25 feet or your land Speed, whichever is SLOWER. Lasts 5 minutes or until Dismissed; once per hour (the existing counters/frequency already track that).

name: Wyrm's Flight
effects: While active: gain a fly Speed equal to your land Speed or 20 feet, whichever is greater. Lasts 10 minutes or until Dismissed, once per day; at 17th level the duration is unlimited and there is no frequency limit.

name: Raging Stories
effects: While active (you Offered a Story and chose the spectral-flame benefit): every MELEE Strike deals +2 additional fire damage; +4 instead if you are a master in Religion, +6 if legendary. Ranged Strikes unaffected.
